interfaces.name: Trip
interfaces.signature: @Model final class Trip { var id: UUID; var name: String; var startDate: Date; var endDate: Date; var isDemo: Bool; var createdAt: Date; @Relationship(deleteRule: .cascade, inverse: \Day.trip) var days: [Day]; @Relationship(deleteRule: .cascade, inverse: \Traveler.trip) var travelers: [Traveler]; @Relationship(deleteRule: .cascade, inverse: \Expense.trip) var expenses: [Expense]; @Relationship(deleteRule: .cascade, inverse: \PackingItem.trip) var packingItems: [PackingItem] }
interfaces.notes: isDemo drives DemoStampBadge everywhere; cloudKitDatabase is .none on the container, never set per-model.

interfaces.name: Day
interfaces.signature: @Model final class Day { var id: UUID; var date: Date; var trip: Trip?; @Relationship(deleteRule: .cascade, inverse: \Stop.day) var stops: [Stop] }
interfaces.notes: Real persisted row per calendar day, never a computed grouping; created eagerly on trip create/range-extend, removable only via the shrink-guard when empty.

interfaces.name: Stop
interfaces.signature: @Model final class Stop { var id: UUID; var day: Day; var sortIndex: Int; var name: String; var address: String; var latitude: Double?; var longitude: Double?; var startTime: Date?; var endTime: Date?; var notes: String; var category: StopCategory; var isCheckedOff: Bool; var calendarEventIdentifier: String? }
interfaces.notes: day is non-optional by design: a Stop existing with no day, or in two days, is the core invariant nothing may violate.

interfaces.name: StopCategory
interfaces.signature: enum StopCategory: String, Codable, CaseIterable { case food, lodging, activity, transit, sight, other }
interfaces.notes: Drives CategoryPin symbol + accessibility label.

interfaces.name: Traveler
interfaces.signature: @Model final class Traveler { var id: UUID; var trip: Trip?; var name: String }
interfaces.notes: Deletion must be blocked while referenced by any Expense.payer or ExpenseSplit.traveler — see TravelerDeletionGuard.

interfaces.name: Expense
interfaces.signature: @Model final class Expense { var id: UUID; var trip: Trip?; var amountCents: Int; var payer: Traveler; var date: Date; var splitMethod: SplitMethod; var notes: String?; @Relationship(deleteRule: .cascade, inverse: \ExpenseSplit.expense) var splits: [ExpenseSplit]; var amount: Decimal { Decimal(amountCents) / 100 } }
interfaces.notes: amountCents is the stored source of truth; amount is a computed Decimal accessor for entry/display only, per DEC-ios_architecture_review-005.

interfaces.name: ExpenseSplit
interfaces.signature: @Model final class ExpenseSplit { var id: UUID; var expense: Expense?; var traveler: Traveler; var shareCents: Int }
interfaces.notes: Sum of shareCents across an expense's splits must equal amountCents exactly; enforced by SettlementEngine, asserted in tests.

interfaces.name: SplitMethod
interfaces.signature: enum SplitMethod: String, Codable { case equal, exact, percentage }

interfaces.name: PackingItem
interfaces.signature: @Model final class PackingItem { var id: UUID; var trip: Trip?; var name: String; var isPacked: Bool; var sortIndex: Int }

interfaces.name: PackingTemplate
interfaces.signature: @Model final class PackingTemplate { var id: UUID; var name: String; @Relationship(deleteRule: .cascade, inverse: \PackingTemplateItem.template) var items: [PackingTemplateItem] }
interfaces.notes: Should-have per DEC-app_features-003; safe to omit from an early build slice without touching other models.

interfaces.name: PackingTemplateItem
interfaces.signature: @Model final class PackingTemplateItem { var id: UUID; var template: PackingTemplate?; var name: String; var sortIndex: Int }

interfaces.name: StopReorderService.moveStop
interfaces.signature: static func moveStop(_ stop: Stop, to destinationDay: Day, at index: Int, context: ModelContext) throws
interfaces.notes: The single atomic function called by both the drag gesture and the 'Move to...' menu; reassigns stop.day, reindexes sortIndex on both source and destination days, saves once, context.rollback() on thrown save.

interfaces.name: SettlementEngine.computeBalances
interfaces.signature: static func computeBalances(expenses: [Expense], travelers: [Traveler]) -> [UUID: Int]
interfaces.notes: Returns net balance in cents keyed by Traveler.id; must satisfy sum(balances) == 0 exactly as an assertable invariant.

interfaces.name: SettlementEngine.minimumTransactions
interfaces.signature: static func minimumTransactions(balances: [UUID: Int]) -> [Payment]
interfaces.notes: Greedy max-debtor/max-creditor debt simplification; must be tested at 5+ travelers, an excluded-payer case, and a non-100%-summing percentage entry (rejected at input, per DEC-detailed_discussion-002, not reaching this function), and at stress scale (8 travelers, 40 expenses).

interfaces.name: Payment
interfaces.signature: struct Payment: Identifiable, Hashable { let id: UUID; let fromTravelerID: UUID; let toTravelerID: UUID; let amountCents: Int }

interfaces.name: TravelerDeletionGuard.blockingExpenses
interfaces.signature: static func blockingExpenses(for traveler: Traveler) -> [Expense]
interfaces.notes: New this phase: mirrors the day-shrink-guard pattern for travelers. Non-empty result blocks deletion and the UI must list the returned expenses, per the same honesty principle as DEC-detailed_discussion-001.

interfaces.name: DayRangeGuard.affectedStops
interfaces.signature: static func affectedStops(trip: Trip, newStartDate: Date, newEndDate: Date) -> [Stop]
interfaces.notes: Implements DEC-detailed_discussion-001's shrink-guard; non-empty result blocks the date-range edit.

interfaces.name: CalendarExportService.exportDay
interfaces.signature: func exportDay(_ day: Day, context: ModelContext) async throws -> CalendarExportResult
interfaces.notes: Uses requestFullAccessToEvents; extracts Sendable stop DTOs before the async EventKit calls, writes calendarEventIdentifier back on the main actor afterward.

interfaces.name: CalendarExportResult
interfaces.signature: struct CalendarExportResult { let created: Int; let updated: Int; let outcome: CalendarExportOutcome }

interfaces.name: CalendarExportOutcome
interfaces.signature: enum CalendarExportOutcome { case success, permissionDenied, permissionRestricted, externallyDeletedEventsDetected(count: Int) }
interfaces.notes: Backs the four distinct confirmation-sheet states from DEC-design_handoff-007.

interfaces.name: DemoSeeder
interfaces.signature: enum DemoSeeder { static let demoTripID: UUID; static func seedIfNeeded(context: ModelContext); static func remove(context: ModelContext) }
interfaces.notes: Singleton keyed by demoTripID per DEC-detailed_discussion-004; must seed at least one Stop with structurally unroutable (open-ocean) coordinates per DEC-ios_architecture_review-012.

interfaces.name: ActiveTripResolver.activeTrip
interfaces.signature: static func activeTrip(in trips: [Trip], now: Date) -> Trip?
interfaces.notes: Used identically by the app, the widget timeline provider, and the Live Activity — the only 'is this trip active' logic in the app.

interfaces.name: CurrentDateProvider.now
interfaces.signature: enum CurrentDateProvider { static func now() -> Date }
interfaces.notes: #if DEBUG reads AppGroupConstants.debugDateOverride from the shared UserDefaults suite; physically compiled out of release builds per DEC-detailed_discussion-006.

interfaces.name: AppGroupConstants
interfaces.signature: enum AppGroupConstants { static let identifier: String; static let debugDateOverrideKey: String }
interfaces.notes: Backs both ModelConfiguration(groupContainer:) and the debug date hook's UserDefaults suite.

interfaces.name: TripGateChecker.canCreateTrip
interfaces.signature: static func canCreateTrip(existingTripCount: Int, isPro: Bool) -> Bool
interfaces.notes: Free tier gate is current trip count at creation time, no isLocked flag on Trip, per DEC-ios_architecture_review-013.

interfaces.name: TripActivityAttributes
interfaces.signature: struct TripActivityAttributes: ActivityAttributes { struct ContentState: Codable, Hashable { var nextStopName: String; var nextStopTime: Date; var isDemo: Bool }; var tripID: UUID }
interfaces.notes: ContentState rendered via Text(timerInterval:); isDemo drives DemoStampBadge inside the Live Activity.

interfaces.name: LiveActivityController
interfaces.signature: enum LiveActivityController { static func start(for trip: Trip) async; static func update(for trip: Trip) async; static func end() async }
interfaces.notes: Every request checks ActivityAuthorizationInfo().areActivitiesEnabled first and uses pushType: nil, per DEC-ios_architecture_review-009.

interfaces.name: NextStopWidgetEntry
interfaces.signature: struct NextStopWidgetEntry: TimelineEntry { let date: Date; let tripName: String?; let nextStopName: String?; let isDemo: Bool; let deepLinkURL: URL? }
interfaces.notes: nextStopName == nil renders the honest 'no active trip' state; deepLinkURL opens the app to that day via widgetURL.

interfaces.name: Theme
interfaces.signature: enum Theme { enum Color; enum Spacing; enum Radius; enum Font }
interfaces.notes: Single source for all tokens from design_handoff; imported by both the app target and the widget extension via WaypointKit.

interfaces.name: DemoStampBadge
interfaces.signature: struct DemoStampBadge: View { init() }
interfaces.notes: Rendered identically by TripSwitcher, DayView, the widget, and the Live Activity — one implementation shared via WaypointKit.

interfaces.name: CategoryPin
interfaces.signature: struct CategoryPin: View { let category: StopCategory; let isSelected: Bool }
interfaces.notes: Custom Annotation content; carries .accessibilityLabel naming category + stop name at the call site.

interfaces.name: WaypointSchemaV1
interfaces.signature: enum WaypointSchemaV1: VersionedSchema { static var models: [any PersistentModel.Type] { [Trip.self, Day.self, Stop.self, Traveler.self, Expense.self, ExpenseSplit.self, PackingItem.self, PackingTemplate.self, PackingTemplateItem.self] } }
interfaces.notes: First entry in a SchemaMigrationPlan set up from day one, so later slices can add fields/models without a destructive reinstall.
